protocol.binaryRequest: 96-byte KCB1 header; SHA-256 identity fingerprint; unit/coordinate metadata; counts/offsets; packed ball/sample float32x4
protocol.binaryResponse: 176-byte KBR1 header; echoed identity fingerprint; reuse/timing/capacity metadata; packed float32 distance/margin/clearance + uint32 classification
protocol.identityMapping: ordered host-side sampleId/edgeId table; strings never cross the worker boundary in binary mode

methodology.comparison: every warmup and measured run checked ordered sample/edge identity, exact classification, finite values, and margin tolerance against Web
methodology.lifecycle: JSON and binary alternate in the same worker PID/generation/context for each size
